{
  "id": "char_09",
  "name": "Derek "Dee" Donovan",
  "role": "Grifter and Charlatan",
  "location": "Underworld alleyways of Newcrest",
  "observable_traits": ["Playful grin", "Quick wit", "Restless eyes"],
  "capabilities": ["Masterful deception", "Smooth talking", "Quick on his feet"],
  "possessions": ["A collection of old, polished pocket watches", "A silver locket with a picture of a woman he never met"],
  "goals": ["Wealth and respect in the underworld", "A life where he doesn't have to lie to survive"],
  "boundaries": ["Won't kill unless absolutely necessary", "Avoids long-term commitments"],
  "relationships": [
    {
      "target": "Velvet Jones",
      "type": "Rival",
      "description": "Competes for the affections of the same underworld figure, leading to tense rivalries."
    },
    {
      "target": "Baxter 'Buck' Rogers",
      "type": "Informant",
      "description": "Relies on Buck's connections for intel, but often forgets to pay up."
    }
  ],
  "history_notes": ["Started grifting in the slums of Newcrest to escape a life of drudgery", "Known for a particularly successful con that landed him a spot in the 'Council of Cunning'"],
  "current_state": "Sitting on a bench, sketching out his next con on a worn napkin, debating whether to pursue the lead on Velvet or Buck.",
  "facts_they_know": ["Believes he is destined for greatness and often speaks of a 'Promised Land' he will reach one day.", "Thinks he can outsmart anyone, even though he's been caught twice before."],
  "beliefs": ["He is more honest than most people give him credit for.", "One day, he will retire to a quiet life abroad."],
  "factual_errors": ["Believes he has a secret admirer among high society, when in reality no one truly admires him."]
